activity.summary: BUG-002: device MQTT CONNECT never confirmed. The AT+CIPSEND '>' prompt and the broker CONNACK bytes are not newline-terminated, so the line-based reader cannot consume either.
BUG-003: the tracker's GNSS wait loop increments an integer by 1000 per iteration instead of using a millis() deadline, so it exits after seconds rather than the intended 15 minutes.

BUG-004 / ADR-002: PRD FR-3.1 names AT+CGNSINF, which does not exist on this module. AT+CGPSINFO is valid. The PRD also assumes PPP, asserts unmeasured NFRs, and omits the working LBS fallback capability entirely.
